skill.name: template-skill
skill.description: Provides a minimal starter structure for creating a custom AI skill with metadata and an instruction placeholder.
skill.summary: Start a custom AI skill from a simple prompt-only template.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The only analyzed file is a minimal prompt-only SKILL.md template with metadata placeholders and no executable behavior. No static or semantic security risks were found.

content.user_title: Create a Custom AI Skill from a Minimal Template
content.value_statement: Starting a skill file from nothing can slow setup and create inconsistent metadata. This template provides a clear structure for metadata and custom instructions.
actual_capabilities: Provides YAML front matter with name and description fields.
Defines template-skill as the default skill name.
Includes a placeholder description for usage conditions.
Marks where authors should add custom instructions.
Offers a prompt-only starter without executable code.
limitations: Requires authors to replace the placeholder metadata before meaningful use.
Does not include examples, workflows, scripts, references, or validation.
Does not enforce instruction quality or safety.

use_cases.title: Start a New Skill
use_cases.description: Create a basic SKILL.md before adding domain instructions, examples, and boundaries.

use_cases.title: Prototype Prompt Behavior
use_cases.description: Draft and revise focused instructions without adding executable components.

use_cases.title: Standardize Skill Entries
use_cases.description: Give contributors a consistent starting structure for new repository skills.

prompt_templates.title: Fill the Basic Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Fill this template for a skill that performs [task]. Write a clear name, usage description, and concise instructions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for one focused task

prompt_templates.title: Define a Domain Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this template into a [domain] skill. Include triggers, required inputs, ordered steps, and expected outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Add Rules and Recovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Design instructions for [workflow]. Add decision rules, failure handling, safety limits, and two short examples while preserving the front matter.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Refine Instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this skill for [audience]. Remove ambiguity, define boundaries, add verification steps, and ensure each instruction is testable.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for reviewing pull requests.
output_examples.output: Suggested name: pull-request-reviewer. The description defines review triggers. Instructions prioritize risks, evidence, file references, and missing tests.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for meeting note summaries.
output_examples.output: Suggested name: meeting-note-summarizer. Instructions identify decisions, owners, deadlines, unresolved questions, and concise follow-up actions.

output_examples.input: Improve a data validation skill template.
output: Clarify accepted input formats and validation rules.
Define error reporting and recovery behavior.
Add representative valid and invalid examples.

best_practices: Replace every placeholder before publishing the skill.
State when the skill should run and what inputs it needs.
Add testable steps, boundaries, and representative examples.
anti_patterns: Do not publish the template with generic placeholder text.
Do not combine unrelated workflows in one skill.
Do not claim tools, files, or permissions the skill does not provide.

faq.question: What does this template include?
faq.answer: It includes YAML metadata and a heading that marks where custom instructions should be added.

faq.question: Does the template perform a task immediately?
faq.answer: No. Authors must replace the placeholders and add task-specific instructions.

faq.question: Can I rename the skill?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace template-skill with a clear name that matches the intended task.

faq.question: Does it include executable code?
faq.answer: No. The analyzed template contains only prompt text and metadata.

faq.question: Which tools can use this template?
faq.answer: The report declares compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I add before publishing?
faq.answer: Add triggers, inputs, ordered instructions, output expectations, boundaries, examples, and verification steps.
